decisive_items: A metal artifact reduction sequence MRI revealed a left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm, without bony involvement or bone‐marrow edema.
Hip aspiration yielded 10,750 white cells/μL; all cultures were negative.
response.rationale: The presence of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass and elevated white cell count in the hip aspiration, along with the patient's symptoms, are most consistent with an adverse local tissue reaction (ALTR).

rejected.why: Negative cultures contradict periprosthetic infection diagnosis.
Chronic inflammation is a nonspecific finding.
Chronic bursitis does not explain the periprosthetic soft-tissue mass.
Absence of bony involvement or bone-marrow edema makes periprosthetic osteolysis less likely.
